safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies penicillin allergy; generated facts only mention unspecified allergies without naming penicillin.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document a penicillin allergy can lead to inadvertent prescribing/administration of a penicillin-class antibiotic in future encounters, potentially causing an allergic reaction ranging from rash to anaphylaxis. Allergy documentation errors are clinically high-risk because they directly affect medication safety.
